items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: So I went on and Nellie Lutcher, bless her heart, she came and she said, "Helen I'll stay right here with you until you go on".

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. It was the New Port thing that was featuring Basie.

And I said, "oh my goodness I haven't even hummed since I've been home. I can't do nothing". He said, "yes you can Helen. Now you can sing." I said, "well it's been so long I don't know whether I can sing or not". He said, "well why don't you come on and try". I said, "because Carnegie Hall is too big to be trying to sing in". And so he said, "well, just come on, you can make it". And I said, "well, alright then, if you think I can make I'll come on and sing something". So I went on and Nellie Lutcher, bless her…
